fieldValues.title: A PDF can carry a whole SRS repository and still read as minutes
fieldValues.summary: A PDF/A-3 printed from a meeting repository reads as ordinary minutes, and its embedded .srs gives an SRS reader the transcript, the enrichment data and a topic map that points at transcript cues; a reader reproduced the printed text from the payload.
evidence: Prototype 2026-11-27: weekly-planning.srs.pdf, payload sha256 70ba8752…; verify.py: 7 checks pass, re-render matches
srs archive pack run twice on the same state: byte-identical
fieldValues.body: Answers the owner's ask directly: read the minutes, and see the transcript, the enrichment and the in-between topic map. Topics carry sourceRefs to the transcript document with the cue range in the note, which is enough for a reader to jump to the words; a first-class cue anchor would be better (SourceAnchor).
